title: Enthusia Autoclicker
body:
# Enthusia AutoClicker

A client-side Minecraft autoclicker designed for controlled, server-approved automation. It uses Minecraft’s normal input and item-use systems without sending fake packets.

## Features
  - Independent left and right clickers
  - Click or hold modes
  - Configurable intervals
  - Timed or unlimited sessions
  - In-game configuration screen and Mod Menu integration
  - Automatic eating when hungry
  - Automatic food restocking and stack merging
  - Armor-stand eating support
  - Durability protection that stops before tools break
  - Server-friendly status messages and safety controls

## Common Uses
  - Farming mobs with an armor stand
  - Holding use to place blocks
  - Repeated harvesting or mining
  - Eating automatically during long farming sessions
  - Protecting valuable tools from breaking
  - Running timed clicking sessions

## Configuration
Set a keybind to toggle on the autoclicker through Minecraft's Controls menu to begin using.

Press O by default to open the settings screen. The key can be changed through Minecraft’s Controls menu. Fabric and Quilt users can also open settings through Mod Menu.

## Compatibility
Separate downloads are provided for each supported Minecraft version and mod loader. Quilt users should install the matching Fabric file.

_This mod does not guarantee compatibility with every server or anticheat configuration. Always follow the rules of the server you are playing on._
